identity.title: Agent0-VL: Exploring Self-Evolving Agent for Tool-Integrated Vision-Language Reasoning

problem.claim: Improve vision-language reasoning through continual self-evolution with integrated tools.

gap.claim: Text-only self-evaluation struggles to verify complex visual reasoning and can produce evaluation hallucinations.

contributions.claim: Agent0-VL integrates tool use into reasoning, self-evaluation, and self-repair for evidence-grounded refinement.
It combines Solver and Verifier roles in a Self-Evolving Reasoning Cycle that couples tool-grounded critique with reinforcement learning.
It performs zero-external-reward evolution without human annotations or external reward models.

stated_novelty.claim: The proposed agent unifies tool-integrated reasoning, verification, and self-repair within a self-evolving vision-language system.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report a 12.5% improvement over the Qwen-VL base model on chart reasoning, geometric problem solving, and visual scientific analysis.

narrative_sequence.summary: LVLM learning is constrained by human-annotated supervision, motivating self-rewarding approaches.
Text-based self-evaluation is described as unreliable for complex visual reasoning because of verification difficulty and evaluation hallucinations.
Agent0-VL uses tools across reasoning, self-evaluation, and self-repair, with Solver and Verifier roles interacting in a self-evolving cycle.
The authors report zero-external-reward continual self-improvement and a 12.5% gain over Qwen-VL across three task areas.

source_observation.claim: The abstract aligns the claimed failure mode—unreliable text-only visual evaluation—with a method that introduces tools specifically for verification and self-repair.

lessons.interpretation: A method is easier to assess when each architectural component is explicitly tied to a named limitation.
lessons.application: When presenting a reasoning system, map each proposed mechanism to the concrete failure mode it is intended to address, then report results on tasks exposing that failure mode.
lessons.exception: This framing is less suitable when the target limitation cannot be isolated or the proposed mechanism addresses several interacting causes without component-level evidence.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the tools, reinforcement-learning procedure, dataset sizes, evaluation protocol, statistical uncertainty, or whether the 12.5% improvement is relative or absolute.
It does not provide separate results for reasoning, verification, or self-repair components.
